environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) running behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in TCP passthrough mode. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy between client and Flask application. SQLite database file at /var/lib/app/users.db with default permissions. Flask running via gunicorn with 4 workers.

config.load_balancer: NLB in TCP mode (no L7 inspection)
